records.section_heading: Summary Sheet: Global warming & climate change In American Samoa
records.question: By what percentage is coral calcification predicted to be reduced over this century due to increased carbon dioxide, according to the summary?
records.ground_truth_answer: Coral calcification is predicted to be reduced by 35% over this century.
ground_truth_chunks: Additionally, increased levels of carbon dioxide (the main greenhouse gas) will reduce the growth (calcification rate) of corals by 35% over this century, so some reefs may erode and others may not be able to keep up with the predicted rate of sea level rise.

records.question: Which locations in American Samoa have National Park temperature monitoring been conducted according to the section?
records.ground_truth_answer: Outer Vatia Bay and Ofu lagoon.
